summary: Conviction for rape, murder, SCST Act atrocities; eyewitness testimony inconsistencies between PW-1 and PW-2; PW-2 testimony unreliable due to tutoring suspicions and delayed recording; recovery evidence deficient—missing time/place details, unexamined witnesses, unverified blood stains; Section 313 CrPC examination inadequate—failure to put incriminating circumstances to accused; standard: reasonable doubt; conviction unsafe without corroborated chain of circumstances.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code s.376, s.302, s.201
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s.366, s.313, s.161
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction set aside; acquittal ordered due to insufficient evidence and procedural violations under Section 313 CrPC.
